name: SLASHER, Interrupted
source:
SLASHER, Interrupted is a visual novel, in which you attempt to tell a horror story whilst your friends interrupt with their own ideas. Will you stick to a cohesive plot, or try and please everyone's ideas at once?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431220/]Steam[/url]]

A standalone sequel to [url=https://communistsister.itch.io/perseids]Perseids[/url]
translation:
《SLASHER, Interrupted》是一部视觉小说。你试图讲述一个恐怖故事，朋友们却不断打断，提出自己的点子。你会坚持情节连贯，还是试着一次满足所有人的想法？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431220/]Steam[/url]]

[url=https://communistsister.itch.io/perseids]Perseids[/url]的独立续作。
